name: orbital-std
description: The 'standard orbital' pipeline kit: the orbital_std/regolith_std cultures, the courier ship, the trade_ring station, the regolith_moon, and the small settlement building set (market_hall, housing_block, admin_office, planter, lamp_post, crates, plus the pipeline bench/column). Originated in graphics_pipeline_test; extracted so any story can reuse the same look with zero new assets.
